transcript: Speaker A (Tomato): Which pasta would you like? White sauce, red sauce, or pink sauce? Speaker B (Okra): I will take the red sauce. Speaker C (Avocado): I'll have the pink sauce. Today you say "I don't understand", tomorrow you will order confidently, and soon people will ask where you learned English. Why wait? Spend 15 minutes daily. Download English Seekho App. There is a ₹1 trial.
